## week-1: C-Programming: Basic Input, Operators -And conditional statements
Lab Report
1. Compulsory programs :-
1. To check whether the number is even or odd:
→ Start the program.
→ Read an integer from the user.
→ Find the remainder when the number is divided by 2.
→ If the remainder is 0, display "It is an even number".
→ End of the program.
2. To check whether the number is positive, Negative or Zero.
→ Start the program.
→ Read an integer from the user.
→ Compare the number with 0.
→ If it is greater than 0, display "It is a positive number", if it is less than 0, display "It is a negative number" otherwise print "It is zero".
→ End of the program.
To check whether a given character is an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit or special character.
→ Start the program.
→ Read the character from the user.
→ Using else if ladder, check the character using logical_AND operator.
→ If the character is 'A' to 'Z' display "It is upper case", if the character is 'a' to 'Z' display "It is lower case" if the character is 'o' to 'q' display "It is lower case"
--- ## 🌍 🔥 display "It is a digit" @, display "It is a special character". → end of the program. 4. To check whether the given year is leap year not. → Read the input from the user. → If it is divided by four, then the remainder either 0's something. → If the remainder is '0' display It is a leap year otherwise print It is not a leap year. → end of the program. To print memory allocation of all types of data in c. → Start the program. → Using int, char, float, unsigned int and signed int, etc. as datatypes. → with the help of size of () operator. Then it displays the memory allocation of all datatypes → end of the program. ## Medium programs: To print arithmetic operations using Switch statement. Start the program. → Read the input from the user as two operands. → Now, print a menu of arithmetic operations like Addition, Subtraction, Multiplication, etc. Enter your choice and the operation will be done using switch case statement
--- → Then the output was given. → End of the program. Program to swap two given numbers without using an extra variable. → Start the program. → Take air variables to store data. → Read input from the user as two numbers → Now, using arithmetic operations, swap the two values of a b. Then the values will be swapped. → Then it prints the values of a d b after swapping. → End of the program. Program to swap two given numbers using a temporary variable. → Take a b,c as variables to store data. → Read the input from the user as two numbers. → Now using third variable as c, swap the values of two variables. → Then it prints the values of a b after swapping. → End of the program. 7. A program to check the given number is perfect square. → Take num, i and initialize the value p=0. as variables → Read the input from the user. → Using for loop initialize the Value i=1, give the condition and then increment should be given in the input. → First it reads the number and check the condition
--- then in each iteration, calculate $ 1 \times 1 $ at compare it with num. → If $ 1 \times 1 $ is equal to num, then increment p by 1 and terminate the loop using break statement. → After that loop, check whether p = 1. If it is p = 1, display 'At is a perfect square' otherwise display "It is not a perfect square". → End of the program. Program to spread a student's marks and print grades. → Start the program. → Take marks as a variable to store data → Read the input from the user. → Using: Else if Statement and using logical AND operators, comparative operators. → Give the condition as per marks and it gives the corresponding grades. → Otherwise print "Fail". → End of the program. Program to print arithmetic operations using the default case and division by zero using a conditional check. → Take a,b, choice as variables to store data → choice is to enter your choice and print the menu of arithmetic operations → Using switch case print the addition, subtraction, multiplication, etc. operations.
--- → Now, using division by 200, print if it is b1=0 and print "Division by 200 is not possible". In default, enter "Invalid choice" and gives the output → end of the program. Program to find the largest of three given numbers only the conditional (ternary) operator. → start the program. → Take a, b, c, largest as variable to store the data. Using ternary operator, compare the three given numbers which were taken from the user. Then it prints the output of largest of three given numbers. → end of the program. Program to converts a numeric grade (0.0 to 4.0) into a letter grade +1- curing switch statement. → start the program. → Read Grade point and which is taken from the user. → Now using switch case statement print'Ak if dec>0.0 #lDec<0.5 otherwise print "A-", like that print the grades. It checks all the conditions which were given in switch statements and then if the condition was wrong then it goes to another condition. → Then the default statement will display, if the user entered an invalid input. → end of the program.
